limitations: Grade estimates share participants and comparison groups; they are not eight independent trials.
Attrition, class switching and first-grade re-randomization complicate interpretation.
Regular classes had some part-time aide access in grades 1–3.
Column 7 excludes teacher covariates; column 8 is a different specification.
Percentile-point effects cannot be ranked directly against Saga standard-deviation effects.
The 2003 economic model's 0.20 SD assumption is not this column's outcome unit.
